findings.summary: CLI `fleet-graph research run --wiki-root` is parsed (cli.py:1285) but never forwarded: `_research_run` (cli.py:78-89) does not pass `args.wiki_root` to `run_research_ticket`, so the flag is silently ignored and the report always falls back to `$FLEET_GRAPH_WIKI_ROOT`/`/data/vault`. The MCP surface wires `wiki_root` correctly (research_mcp.py:54-102), so the three surfaces are not uniformly wired for report placement.
